name: ping-ai-state
objective: Show a coherent transient afferent wave briefly recruiting PING at fixed recurrent weights before the network returns to its irregular background state.
arrow_rule: Draw sampled active projection paths and direction-bearing arrows for current-timestep transmissions; retain every event in the complete raster.
conductance_style: Persistent connection width and opacity follow reconstructed per-synapse AMPA or GABA conductance after spike arrival and exponential decay.
neuron_radius: Mapped from recorded membrane voltage between resting and threshold voltage; spike rings remain explicit after voltage reset.
input_visual: Shared, E-targeting and I-targeting excitatory afferents have separate complete rasters and sampled active projection arrows. Private AMPA/GABA events appear as target-cell marks; locally shared events appear as neighbourhood washes; the stationary rate envelope has its own trace.
visual_style: Conference-figure warm off-white; restrained typography; excitatory structure black; inhibitory structure red.
